title: docs(skills): teach controlled_by_parent with an optional master in the data skill, permission docs and ADR-0055
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xWhCfdfW618LQz4eew6Gh2g)_

Fixes #30907
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：数据技能（`skills/objectstack-data` 的 `rules/relationships.md`、`rules/security.md`、`references/lint-rules.md`、`SKILL.md`）、五个权限文档页和 ADR-0055 现在教「可选主表」：`controlled_by_parent` 子对象把它唯一的 `master_detail` 写成 `required: false`，不再教「复制一个属主字段再用钩子同步」。没挂主表的行归属主：属主或子对象「查看全部」可读，属主或子对象「修改全部」可写；新建不挂主表的行直接放行；挂主表要对新主记录有编辑权，清空主表要对原主记录有编辑权（`ownerMayEdit` 不覆盖）；链上某跳没有主表就在那里按同一规则结束。另加一句：成员键的 `valueField` 不能是名册对象自己的 `id`（`membership-key-value-field-invalid`）。ADR-0055 新增 2026-11-07 的 §3 修订，并就地标注 2026-11-06 那行「§3 不变」。
- **为什么改**：您对 #30905 的裁决「A」分三张卡落地；第 1、2 张（PR #30940、#31082）已合并，平台已支持可选主表的读和写，但技能和文档还在教「主表必须必填」或复制属主字段的老路。这是第 3 张。
- **风险与回滚**：只改技能文本、文档、ADR 和一个 changeset，无运行时影响；四个技能文件都在 token 天花板内（棘轮行不动）；回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` 新增的「Optional master」小节，以及 ADR-0055 末尾的 2026-11-07 修订。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期 exit 0，读数见下文 Token budget。
- **需要你做的**：`skills/**` 和 `docs/adr/**` 属 Tier H，需要 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准。

## What changes, and the code behind each taught fact

Every fact was read on `main` `719a502b` (after PR #30940 for #30905 and PR #31082 for #30906):

| Taught | Source on `main` |
|:--|:--|
| The object's **only** `master_detail` declared `required: false` is the master when no required one stands (an optional master) | `packages/spec/src/data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts` `controlledByParentMasterOf`, judged by `controlledByParentMasterRefusal` (the parse's refinement in `object.zod.ts`) |
| Still refused: `required: false` beside a second `master_detail`; a `readonly` / `system` master (required or optional); an omitted `required` is forced to `true` by `ObjectSchema.create()` | same module (`several-masters`, `master-not-writable`); `object.zod.ts` `forceCbpMasterDetailRequired`; lint `relationship/master-detail-required` (`packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts` `cbpMasterReferenceFinding`) |
| A null-master row is read by its owner (`owner_id`) and by View All on the detail; no owner / no `owner_id` column ⇒ View All alone | `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-cbp-read-filter.ts` `computeControlledByParentFilter` (the `nullMasterArm`) |
| A null-master row is written by its owner or Modify All on the detail (everyone else `403`, View All included); no owner ⇒ Modify All alone | `security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts` `nullMasterRowWritable`, and the `masterId == null && rel.optional` block of `assertControlledByParentWrite` |
| An insert naming no master is admitted | same block: `if (operation === 'insert') return;` |
| Setting a master asks edit on it; emptying one asks edit on the stored master, and `ownerMayEdit` does not cover it | `askBodyNamedMaster` after the owner rule; the `ownerMayEdit` leg's `!(rel.optional && bodyEmptiesMasterReference(...))` |
| A chain hop with no master ends there under the same rule | the chain walk's `nextMasterId == null && nextRel.optional` branch (`nullMasterRowWritable` on the master's own object) |
| A membership key's `valueField` cannot be the roster's own `id` | `packages/lint/src/validate-membership-key-declarations.ts`: `columnOf` maps `id` to an empty slice, `valueFieldFault` reports it `membership-key-value-field-invalid` |

**Skills.** `rules/relationships.md` gains § Optional master (after the `ownerMayEdit` section), and its `master_detail` table row names it. `rules/security.md`: the "choose by what the rows are keyed on" list gains "a parent's owner, parent optional → an optional master", and the `valueField` note gains the `id` refusal. `SKILL.md`: the OWD table's `controlled_by_parent` row says a row with no (optional) master is its owner's. `references/lint-rules.md`: the `relationship/master-detail-required` row names the optional master.

**Docs** (`content/docs/permissions/`): `authorization.mdx` (the lint-gate bullet, ≈L539: one master, required or optional, and what `no-relation` / `ambiguous-relation` now catch), `rls.mdx` (the controlled-by-parent bullet), `sharing-rules.mdx` (OWD table row), `permissions-matrix.mdx` (OWD table row), `index.mdx` (a comment on the example's `contact: 'controlled_by_parent'`).

**ADR-0055.** A new section "Amendment (2026-11-07, #30906): the null-master row its owner writes", a status line for it, and an inline ⚠️ note at §3. The 2026-11-06 status line's "§3 … is unchanged" is marked in place (⚠️ Amended 2026-11-07), as are the three sentences inside the 2026-11-06 amendment that said the same (its Ruling paragraph's "amended again for §3 then", its Fail-closed bullet on the write gate, its "What is unchanged" §3). Nothing is rewritten.

## Token budget

`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (convention `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`), no ratchet row moved, `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` untouched:

| File | `main` | head | ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 6078 | 6071 | 6078 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` | 3688 | 3696 | 3698 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` | 3838 | 3870 | 3873 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md` | 935 | 958 | 970 |

(The order's SKILL.md reading of 6068 had moved to 6078/6078 on `main` `719a502b`.) No copied-owner-field recipe existed in these files to replace, so the growth is paid by deleting restatement in the same file; `lint-rules.md`'s +23 is one table row and stays under its ceiling with no deletion. Each deletion and its surviving home:

`rules/relationships.md`
1. The intro "Guide for modeling relationships between objects using `lookup`, `master_detail`, and junction patterns." Home: the H1 and the ToC lines above it.
2. § Delete Behaviors' fence `{ type: 'master_detail', reference: 'parent_object', deleteBehavior: 'cascade', // or 'restrict' — 'set_null' is refused here }`. Home: the sentence and table right above it ("`cascade` or `restrict` **only**; an authored `set_null` is refused").
3. § Roll-up Summaries "and never summed on the client". Home: "**server-side**" in the same sentence.
4. § Roll-up Summaries "Pairs naturally with inline editing (below): the parent total updates atomically as line items are saved." Home: the same section's "inside the same transaction as the write" and § Inline Editing's "saves parent + children in **one atomic transaction**".
5. § Inline Editing "— with no form-view config and no bespoke page". Home: the section's first sentence ("in the data model — not in a form view").
6. § Inline Editing "but the relationship `inlineEdit` is the primary, zero-config path". Home: the same first sentence.
7. ❌ Incorrect's comment `// Invoice line items should NOT be independent`. Home: the heading and the fence's own `// ❌ Child can exist without parent — wrong!`.
8. ✅ Correct's fence (`invoice_line_item` with a required `master_detail`, `deleteBehavior: 'cascade'`), replaced by a link to § One-to-Many: master_detail, which declares the same object and field.

`rules/security.md`
1. The RLS example's comments `// rows readable / targetable` and `// every row written`. Home: the prose right above ("`using` admits rows …", "`check` is judged on every row an `insert`/`update` writes").
2. § Membership keys intro "rather than on a person or a position". Home: the same section's "Choose by what the rows are keyed on" list.

`SKILL.md`
1. "See [rules/relationships.md](./rules/relationships.md) for detailed examples." under the Relationship Patterns table. Home: the Quick Reference link to Relationships.

## Eval sweep

`grep` over `skills/objectstack-data/evals/*.json` for `controlled_by_parent`, `master_detail`, `required`, `owner`, `hook`, `copy`/`mirror`/`stamp` and `membership`: **no case pins the old rule.** `objects-fields-relationships.json` case 2 expects `required: true` on an invoice line's `master_detail`, which stays right (a line always has its invoice). `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` case 6 (membership keys for portal orders) and case 1 (the search-mirror hooks) teach rules this card leaves standing. No eval file is changed.

## Scorer check (read-only)

`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-tags.ts` row-scope check, now at **L393** (the card's L343 drifted): `if (effectiveSharingModel(def) === 'private' || def.sharingModel === 'controlled_by_parent') return check(at, true, model);`. It accepts any `controlled_by_parent` object without reading its master's `required`, so an optional-master detail passes. No change.

## Spec contract jsdoc owed (spec lane, not edited here)

The wording `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts` owes (`master_chain`, `master_reference_missing`, `checkControlledByParentWrite`) is filed for the spec lane as #31094.

## Other `content/docs` pages that still teach a required-only master

Listed, not widened: filed as #31095 (`error-handling.mdx`, `error-catalog.mdx`, `cli.mdx`, including the two sites the contract review added). Release pages (`content/docs/releases/**`) are release-owned.

## Review round 1

Contract review FAIL at `197aa7c88` (comment 6703355433). Fixed in delta commit `9cea5ade1`, as the seat ordered (one new commit, no rebase or force-push):

- **M1** (`rules/relationships.md` § Optional master): "emptying one asks edit on the stored master, `ownerMayEdit` aside" now reads "…, even under `ownerMayEdit`", matching the owner leg's `!(rel.optional && bodyEmptiesMasterReference(opCtx.data, rel.fk))` in `security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts`.
- **S1** (`rules/relationships.md` § Owner edits): "every write needs edit access on the master" now reads "every write of a row naming a master needs edit on it", and "on-behalf-of writes still need master edit" reads "on-behalf-of writes under a master still need its edit", so neither contradicts § Optional master (an insert naming no master is admitted; the owner rule governs a null-master row).
- **S2** (ADR-0055, 2026-11-07 amendment): the owner-rule bullet's `403` is now said of a principal who reaches the gate; one who cannot read the row meets the read door's `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` first (step 2.7), as #31082 pinned.
- **S3 / S4**: the other docs pages and the spec jsdoc are filed by the seat as #31095 and #31094; this body points to them instead of listing them.

The delta costs `rules/relationships.md` 6 tokens (3865 → 3871, ceiling 3873); no deletion was added and no ratchet row moved.

## Review round 2

Delta review PASS at `9cea5ade1` (comment 6703520499), no must-fix. Its should-fix **S5**, closed here as the seat ordered, in delta commit `a60b01a6e`: `rules/relationships.md` § Owner edits opened "A `controlled_by_parent` detail inherits the master's access: reads are scoped to accessible masters", which left out the null-master read (the owner and View All, § Optional master). It now reads "A `controlled_by_parent` detail row naming a master inherits its access: reads are scoped to accessible masters and **every write needs edit on the master**", so the read and the write halves both speak of a row that names a master (S1's write qualifier moves into the subject). The change is net −1 token (3871 → 3870, ceiling 3873); no deletion was needed and no ratchet row moved.

## Review tier

`dispatch-gates` mandates the contract-review tier for `skills/**` and `docs/adr/**` (clause ①); that is waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03). The seat runs the contract review.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset (`'@objectstack/skills': patch`), and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The `维护者速读` section is the maintainer's Chinese summary the fleet asks for.)
